parameters.query:
WITH week AS (SELECT NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AS start)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE created_at >= (SELECT start FROM week)) AS new_leads,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE status = 'converted' AND converted_at >= (SELECT start FROM week)) AS conversions,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM sales WHERE sold_at >= (SELECT start FROM week)) AS revenue,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments WHERE appointment_at >= (SELECT start FROM week) AND appointment_at < NOW()) AS appointments_done,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments WHERE appointment_at >= NOW() AND appointment_at <= NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days') AS appointments_upcoming;

SELECT full_name, email, source, created_at
FROM leads
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 10;

const metrics = $input.first().json; const leads = $input.last().json; const leadsList = Array.isArray(leads) ? leads : [leads]; const leadRows = leadsList .filter(l => l.full_name) .map(l => `${l.full_name}${l.email || '-'}${l.source || '-'}`) .join(''); const html = `

Haftalık Rapor — ${new Date().toLocaleDateString('tr-TR')}

Yeni lead${metrics.new_leads}
Dönüşüm${metrics.conversions}
Hafta geliri${metrics.revenue} TL
Tamamlanan randevu${metrics.appointments_done}
Yaklaşan randevu (7 gün)${metrics.appointments_upcoming}

Son 10 Lead

${leadRows}
İsimEmailKaynak
`; return [{ json: { subject: `Haftalık Rapor — ${metrics.new_leads} lead, ${metrics.revenue} TL`, html } }];
